data.body: Addressed all three Gerrit LLM-review advisories in patchset 2. The two overlapping count/range findings are resolved by deriving the expected criterion cardinality and T-overlay bounds from CANONICAL_LLM before comparing them to the hand-authored doc. The fixed 1000-character T15 slice is replaced by a reusable Markdown bullet-boundary helper, so product-name negative checks cannot bleed into adjacent guidance. Rebased cleanly onto origin/main 104dc4e10a (incoming commit had no file overlap). Refreshed gates: 37 focused tests passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed (512 files); diff check and canonical trailer verification passed.
